text: When we stop taking turns and one partner has become the default caregiver, and that’s taken for granted, it’s time to bring in other support, or the romance could collapse under the burden. Maybe the romance actually does need less intensity, maybe it becomes a friendship, or maybe it ends. Asking each other out loud which it should be is usually how that change begins, though I can’t answer that for others (and couldn’t always answer it for myself).
section: Different levels in different domains can be complementary
